items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Einkommensteuerbescheid 2025
items.quote: Dieser Bescheid kann mit dem Einspruch angefochten werden. Die Einspruchsfrist beträgt einen Monat und rechnet ab der Bekanntgabe; ein Bescheid, der als Brief verschickt wird, ist am vierten Tag nach dem Absenden als bekannt gegeben anzusehen.
items.computation: Letter is dated Wed 18.11.2026 and is presumed posted that day. Under the statutory three-day delivery fiction of § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO (the letter's own text wrongly says 'vierten Tag' - fourth day - but the law in force provides for the third day), day 3 after posting is Sat 21.11.2026; since that falls on a Saturday, the (post-2017) rule shifts deemed delivery to the next business day, Mon 23.11.2026 (not a public holiday in Saarland). Per § 355 AO the one-month Einspruchsfrist runs from this Bekanntgabe. Under § 108 Abs. 1 AO i.V.m. §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB, the day of Bekanntgabe (23.11.) is excluded and the period runs to the day in the next month bearing the same number, i.e. 23.12.2026. That date is a Wednesday, not a weekend or Saarland public holiday, so no further shift applies.

warnings: The letter states the postal-delivery fiction as the 'vierten Tag' (fourth day) after posting, but the statutory rule currently in force under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO is the third day (with a shift to the next business day if that day is a weekend/holiday); I used the legally correct three-day rule to compute the Einspruch deadline (23.12.2026) rather than the letter's stated fourth-day rule, which would otherwise suggest 22.11.2026 (a Sunday, shifting to 23.11.2026) as the Bekanntgabe date - the practical outcome for the deadline is the same end date either way in this case, but the discrepancy in the letter's wording should be noted.
